lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Arjun, good to see you. Let's get you ready for Monday's partner meeting.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: Thanks Aditi. Payout volume crossed four million dollars last month across three gig platforms.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: The partners will ask about bank dependency. Who is your sponsor bank today?

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: One sponsor bank. Our last raise closed in six weeks, but the bank question came up every time.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Fable Bank would be a strong second partner. I'll intro you to Raj Malhotra at Fable Bank by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: That would be great. I'll send the updated unit economics by Friday.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: If Fable comes on board, we'd launch the second rail in Pune first.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: I'll also line up three gig platform references for your team.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Great. See you Monday.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Ishaan, thanks for the quick turnaround on the draft terms.

lines.speaker: Ishaan Verma
lines.text: Of course. The main open points are the option pool and the pro rata language.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: We'd want a board seat if we lead, that's standard for us.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: I'll send you our term sheet markup by Friday.

lines.speaker: Ishaan Verma
lines.text: Thanks. I'll get you the cap table with the ESOP pool by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Ishaan Verma
lines.text: And I'll send you our legal counsel's contact today.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Sounds good, speak Thursday.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Let's plan the Q3 letter.

lines.speaker: Vikram Nair
lines.text: I'll have the Q3 LP letter draft to you by the 24th.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: I'll write the portfolio highlights paragraph by the 26th.

lines.speaker: Vikram Nair
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Vikram, Lata, let's go through the board agenda for the 23rd.

lines.speaker: Lata Krishnan
lines.text: I'll send the September MIS by the 20th.

lines.speaker: Vikram Rao
lines.text: And I'll add the hiring plan to the board deck by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: I'll review the full board deck before the meeting, by the 22nd.

lines.speaker: Vikram Rao
lines.text: Thanks Aditi.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Katherine, great to meet properly.

lines.speaker: Katherine Fernandes
lines.text: We considered building a consumer product last year but dropped it.

lines.speaker: Katherine Fernandes
lines.text: I'll send the bank pipeline list by next Friday.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: I'll intro you to Omar at Coastline Bank.

lines.speaker: Katherine Fernandes
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Mohan, how are the co-op bank go-lives going?

lines.speaker: Mohan Kulkarni
lines.text: Three banks are live. I'll intro you to the GM at Kaveri Cooperative Bank.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: I'll share the co-op bank partnership deck by next week.

lines.speaker: Mohan Kulkarni
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Neel, let's look at the burn increase.

lines.speaker: Neel Bhatt
lines.text: I'll send the revised hiring plan by the 15th.

lines.speaker: Vikram Nair
lines.text: I'll model the runway scenarios by next Friday.

lines.speaker: Neel Bhatt
lines.text: Thanks both.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Akhil, let's close out the documents.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Arvind from our counsel will send his comments by Friday.

lines.speaker: Akhil Menon
lines.text: I'll send the signed board resolution by Monday.

lines.speaker: Akhil Menon
lines.text: And I'll send the stamp duty receipt today.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Thanks Akhil.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Varun, the partners vote next week.

lines.speaker: Varun Khanna
lines.text: I'll send the final cap table by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: I'll let you know the partner vote outcome by Monday.

lines.speaker: Varun Khanna
lines.text: Thank you.
